help.disable: Disabling is a reversible pause: linked credentials are kept, but new links are rejected and subscription-backed inference is blocked server-side. Users keep their Aurvek credits and BYOK keys. This does not purge stored credentials.
help.enable: Allow users to connect and use their external subscription
help.no_models: No models have been synchronized yet. They are populated automatically after the first successful account link.
help.runtime: The server refuses to enable this switch unless the dedicated key, private runtime, exact Codex binary and isolated initialize/teardown probe all pass.
subtitle: Master kill switch for the subscription-auth option
error.emergency_off: GPTSub was disabled by a runtime safety check. Fix the runtime, restart Aurvek and rerun the diagnostic tool.
error.runtime_not_ready: GPTSub is not ready. Keep the switch off and run the production diagnostic tool, which does not disclose secrets.
error.request_rejected: The request was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
